description: AbstractTexture is the abstract superclass to represent the common attributes of the classes ParameterizedTexture and GeoreferencedTexture.

properties.name: imageURI
properties.description: Specifies the URI that points to the external texture image.

properties.name: mimeType
properties.description: Specifies the MIME type of the texture image.

properties.name: codeSpace
properties.description: Specifies the code space of the MIME type, typically a dictionary, thesaurus, classification scheme, authority, or pattern for the MIME type.

properties.name: textureType
properties.description: Indicates the specific type of the texture.

properties.name: wrapMode
properties.description: Specifies the behaviour of the texture when the texture is smaller than the surface to which it is applied.

properties.name: borderColor
properties.description: Specifies the color of that part of the surface that is not covered by the texture.
